claim: DERIVED: with static resident weights, detector time integration amortises read-out only over spatial fan-in N; the extra factor T of N*T requires a different weight in each time slot
quote: In this way, the weight can be modulated as fast as the input vector, which is crucial for this matrix architecture.
notes: DERIVED: integrating T symbols with a fixed weight w_ij gives w_ij * sum_t x_j(t), i.e. one MAC on a time-summed input, not T MACs. T distinct MACs per read-out need w_ij(t) (Muenster fast MZM, HEANA FIFO R11-055, Netcast broadcast R7-001, TFLN 2 DAC/MAC R7-017). Static-weight charge-domain systems found (ACCEL R11-041, MIT US11546077 R11-005/R11-006) integrate over spatial fan-in only. So H1's 'laser and read-out shared over N*T MACs' holds for N only unless weights are streamed (which removes the zero-weight-fetch benefit).

claim: DERIVED: PDONN whole-system energy per inference and per MAC vs H1 core estimate

SI S4 shares (R11-037..R11-039): laser 6.45/10.57 = 61%, heaters 2.72 = 26%, VOA input loading 0.96 = 9%, external circuits 0.41 = 4%, NAFs 0.03 = 0.3%; replacing heaters with PCM/MEMS removes 26% only; the laser WPE term dominates.
